name: when-the-network-goes-dark-data
title: When the Network Goes Dark: Gulf Coast cell-site outages in hurricanes, 2017-2026 (data and code)
description: County-by-report panel of FCC Disaster Information Reporting System (DIRS) cell-site outages for 22 Atlantic hurricanes and tropical storms in ten Gulf and Southeast states, 2017-2026, checked against each report's printed totals, with the inputs and code that rebuild it.
spatialCoverage: Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia (United States), county level

resources.name: dirs_county_day
resources.title: FCC DIRS cell-site outages by county and report
resources.description: One row per county per FCC DIRS report in use (169 reports, 22 storms).

fields.name: storm_key
fields.description: Storm key: NHC ID and DIRS activation date, joined by an underscore.
fields.limitations: Names repeat across years (Isaias 2020 and 2026); always join on this key, not the name.

fields.name: nhc_id
fields.description: National Hurricane Center storm ID (basin, number, year).

fields.name: storm
fields.description: Storm name.
fields.limitations: Not unique across years.

fields.name: dirs_activation_date
fields.description: Date the FCC activated DIRS for the storm.

fields.name: rule_period
fields.description: FCC rule period by activation date. P0: Voluntary DIRS, voluntary Framework (2016-01-01 to 2024-04-30); P1: MDRI in force, DIRS voluntary (2024-05-01 to 2025-02-19); P2: MDRI + mandatory DIRS (2025-02-20 to 2026-06-29); P3: Streamlined DIRS (FCC 26-34) (2026-06-30 to present).
fields.limitations: Descriptive grouping only; periods differ in storms, hazards and filers.

fields.name: doc_id
fields.description: FCC EDOCS document number of the report.

fields.name: report_date
fields.description: Date of the report.

fields.name: as_of_utc
fields.description: The report's stated as-of time, in UTC.
fields.limitations: Where the report prints none, set to 12:00 Eastern on the report date (as_of_imputed).

fields.name: as_of_imputed
fields.description: True when as_of_utc was set to 12:00 Eastern because the report prints no time.

fields.name: report_status
fields.description: Validation status of the report (step 4): ok, flagged (a check raised a note) or known_fcc_inconsistency (a stated total the FCC's own rows do not sum to, listed in code/manifest/known_fcc_inconsistencies.csv).
fields.limitations: Excluded reports are not in the file.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State, as printed.
fields.limitations: Ten study states only.

fields.name: county
fields.description: County as printed by the FCC (upper case).
fields.limitations: Spellings vary between reports; use fips.

fields.name: fips
fields.description: Five-digit county FIPS code (with leading zero).
fields.limitations: Mapped from the printed name with code/manifest/fips_exceptions.csv.

fields.name: sites_served
fields.description: Cell sites served in the county, as reported.
fields.limitations: The denominator differs by storm and report; compare percentages with care. Cell sites as reported by providers to the FCC; a site out is not a count of people without service (the FCC's caveat).

fields.name: sites_out
fields.description: Cell sites out of service in the county, as reported.
fields.limitations: Cell sites as reported by providers to the FCC; a site out is not a count of people without service (the FCC's caveat).

fields.name: pct_out
fields.description: Percent of sites out, as printed (computed from the two counts where not printed).
fields.limitations: Where pct_printed is false the value is computed, not printed.

fields.name: pct_printed
fields.description: True when the report printed the percent column.

fields.name: out_damage
fields.description: Sites out due to damage, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns. Causes can overlap (see out_overattributed).

fields.name: out_transport
fields.description: Sites out due to transport (backhaul), as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns.

fields.name: out_power
fields.description: Sites out due to power, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns.

fields.name: on_backup_power
fields.description: Sites operating on backup power, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no such column. Not a measure of sites about to fail.

fields.name: out_unattributed
fields.description: Sites out with no cause given: sites_out minus the three causes, never below 0.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns. Kept apart from out_overattributed; never net them.

fields.name: out_overattributed
fields.description: Causes in excess of sites out (sites counted under more than one cause).
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns.

fields.name: area_status
fields.description: Whether the county is in the FCC's notice area on the report date: inside, inside_spelling_variant, outside_notice_area or table_not_in_list.
fields.limitations: From the FCC's notices (code/manifest/reporting_areas.csv).

fields.name: fema_declared
fields.description: True if OpenFEMA lists a declaration for the storm covering the county.
fields.limitations: Context for reuse only; no result uses it. This product uses the Federal Emergency Management Agency's OpenFEMA API, but is not endorsed by FEMA.

fields.name: time_flag
fields.description: Blank, or pre_onset_likely_marco for Laura's Aug 25, 2020 report (the FCC's combined Marco and Laura report), which is kept but left out of every time-based result.

resources.description: One row per storm with a DIRS activation in scope, including storms with no usable report.

fields.limitations: Not unique across years.

fields.name: previous_landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0 under the original rule (kept for chapter 8's comparison).
fields.limitations: Superseded; not used for the main results.

fields.name: interim_landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0 under the first 2026-11-23 rule (kept for comparison).
fields.limitations: Superseded; not used for the main results.

fields.name: n_reports
fields.description: Reports in the panel.
fields.limitations: Blank for storms not in the panel.

fields.name: n_counties
fields.description: Counties in the panel.
fields.limitations: Blank for storms not in the panel.

fields.name: first_report
fields.description: First report date in the panel.

fields.name: last_report
fields.description: Last report date in the panel.
fields.limitations: The FCC's last public report, not the end of outages.

fields.name: excluded_reports
fields.description: Reports left out, with date and reason.

fields.name: in_panel
fields.description: True if the storm has at least one report in the panel.

resources.name: panel_analysis_ready
resources.title: Analysis-ready panel: the county-report panel with every covariate the analysis uses
resources.description: The rows of dirs_county_day.csv, in the same order, joined with EAGLE-I power outages and coverage flags, exposure and wind zone, day 0, SVI 2022, ACS 2022 and the BDC provider counts and chapter 13 group. Built by code/src/12b_analysis_ready.py; load it with load_panel() in code/src/load.py. Counts are integers; other numbers are written to 10 significant digits.

fields.name: eaglei_time
fields.description: Time of the EAGLE-I record matched to the report's as-of time.
fields.limitations: Blank when no record lies within 30 minutes.

fields.name: eaglei_match
fields.description: EAGLE-I match at the as-of time: matched, no_record_within_30min, county_not_in_eaglei_window, no_as_of_time or no_eaglei_release (Isaias 2026; EAGLE-I ends in 2025).

fields.name: eaglei_gap_min
fields.description: Minutes between the matched record and the as-of time.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out
fields.description: Electricity customers out at the as-of time.
fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_6h
fields.description: Customers out 6 hours before the as-of time.
fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_12h
fields.description: Customers out 12 hours before.
fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_24h
fields.description: Customers out 24 hours before.
fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_zero_filled
fields.description: As eaglei_customers_out, with no record counted as 0 where the county has an EAGLE-I record in the storm's window.
fields.limitations: Sensitivity display only.

fields.name: eaglei_modeled_customers
fields.description: EAGLE-I modeled customers in the county (MCC.csv).
fields.limitations: Below observed outages in some counties; see eaglei_mcc_flag.

fields.name: eaglei_pct_out
fields.description: eaglei_customers_out as a percent of eaglei_modeled_customers.
fields.limitations: Not used where eaglei_mcc_flag is not ok.

fields.name: eaglei_max_out_in_window
fields.description: Highest customers out in the storm's EAGLE-I window (21 days before activation to 21 days after deactivation).

fields.name: eaglei_release
fields.description: True if EAGLE-I covers the storm's year (through 2025).

fields.name: eaglei_mcc_flag
fields.description: ok, mcc_below_observed_outages (percent out not used) or no_mcc.

fields.name: eaglei_coverage_flag
fields.description: ok, low_coverage (state's minimum covered share below 0.75 that year; kept), coverage_unknown (no published coverage for the year) or no_eaglei_release.
fields.limitations: Coverage is published by state and year only (2018-2022).

fields.name: eaglei_state_min_covered
fields.description: State's minimum share of customers covered by EAGLE-I in the storm year.
fields.limitations: Blank when not published.

fields.name: eaglei_state_max_covered
fields.description: State's maximum share of customers covered in the storm year.
fields.limitations: Blank when not published.

fields.name: min_dist_km
fields.description: Distance from the county's Census internal point to the storm's track (15-minute interpolation).
fields.limitations: NHC HURDAT2; Isaias 2026 from the GIS best track.

fields.name: wind_kt_at_closest
fields.description: Storm's maximum sustained wind at the track point closest to the county.

fields.name: in_34kt
fields.description: True if the county's internal point fell inside the 34-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: in_50kt
fields.description: True if inside the 50-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: in_64kt
fields.description: True if inside the 64-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: wind_zone
fields.description: Chapter 7's wind zone from the three radii: inside 64 kt, 50-64 kt, 34-50 kt or outside 34 kt.

fields.name: first_34kt_utc
fields.description: First time the county was inside the 34-knot wind radii.
fields.limitations: Blank if never inside.

fields.name: nearest_landfall_utc
fields.description: The storm's HURDAT2 landfall nearest the county.
fields.limitations: Blank for Isaias 2026 (no landfall marker in the GIS best track).

fields.name: nearest_landfall_km
fields.description: Distance from the county to that landfall.

fields.name: track_source
fields.description: HURDAT2 or GIS best track (Isaias 2026).

fields.name: landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0: the first time the storm's 34-knot wind radii reach a study-state county.
fields.limitations: Same for every county of a storm; see storms.csv.

fields.name: landfall_source
fields.description: Which rule set day 0.

fields.name: days_since_landfall
fields.description: Deprecated alias of days_since_day0 (same values), kept until 4.0.0.
fields.limitations: Use days_since_day0: day 0 is not always a landfall (see landfall_source).

fields.name: days_since_day0
fields.description: Days from day 0 to the report's as-of time (since 3.1.0).

fields.name: svi_overall
fields.description: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 overall national percentile rank (RPL_THEMES).
fields.limitations: Chapter 8's quartiles are of the at-risk storm-counties, not of this column's national cut points.

fields.name: svi_socioeconomic
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 1, socioeconomic status (RPL_THEME1).

fields.name: svi_household
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 2, household characteristics (RPL_THEME2).

fields.name: svi_minority_language
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 3, racial and ethnic minority status (RPL_THEME3).

fields.name: svi_housing_transport
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 4, housing type and transportation (RPL_THEME4).

fields.name: acs_households
fields.description: Households, ACS 2022 5-year (B11001_001E).

fields.name: acs_population
fields.description: Population, ACS 2022 5-year (B01001_001E).

fields.name: acs_pct_65plus
fields.description: Percent of the population aged 65 or over, ACS 2022 5-year (B01001).

fields.name: acs_pct_broadband
fields.description: Percent of households with a broadband subscription, ACS 2022 5-year (B28002_004E / B28002_001E).

fields.name: bdc_release
fields.description: FCC Broadband Data Collection release matched to the storm: the latest on or before day 0, or the earliest for storms before 2022.

fields.name: bdc_role
fields.description: main (storms from 2022 on) or sensitivity: network data from after the storm.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_half
fields.description: Mobile providers covering at least half the county's area (chapter 13's main measure).
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out; providers are never named.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_any
fields.description: Mobile providers with any coverage in the county.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_any_excl_near_universal
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service, near-universal providers excluded.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_any
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_half
fields.description: Fixed providers serving at least half of residential locations.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_half_excl_near_universal
fields.description: As bdc_fixed_half, near-universal providers excluded.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_half_group
fields.description: Chapter 13's group on bdc_mobile_half: 2 or fewer, 3, or 4 or more (cut points fixed from counts only; results.json v2_5_groups).
fields.limitations: For storms before 2022 (bdc_role 'sensitivity') the release postdates the storm; chapter 13's main analysis uses storms from 2022 on.

fields.name: first_report_date
fields.description: The county's first report in the storm's panel.

fields.name: last_report_date
fields.description: The county's last report in the storm's panel.

fields.name: n_reports_county
fields.description: Reports in the storm's panel that list the county.

fields.name: censoring
fields.description: none, left_reports_while_out (left the reports before the storm's last report while still out) or out_at_last_report.
fields.limitations: Censored counties are not recovered.

fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_24h
fields.description: Customers out 24 hours before.
fields.limitations: ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I (CC BY 4.0); 'customers' are meters. Blank where no EAGLE-I record lies within 30 minutes of the time (never set to zero); see eaglei_match.

fields.name: eaglei_customers_out_zero_filled
fields.description: As eaglei_customers_out, with no record counted as 0 where the county has an EAGLE-I record in the storm's window.
fields.limitations: Sensitivity display only.

fields.name: eaglei_modeled_customers
fields.description: EAGLE-I modeled customers in the county (MCC.csv).
fields.limitations: Below observed outages in some counties; see eaglei_mcc_flag.

fields.name: eaglei_pct_out
fields.description: eaglei_customers_out as a percent of eaglei_modeled_customers.
fields.limitations: Not used where eaglei_mcc_flag is not ok.

fields.name: eaglei_max_out_in_window
fields.description: Highest customers out in the storm's EAGLE-I window (21 days before activation to 21 days after deactivation).

fields.name: eaglei_release
fields.description: True if EAGLE-I covers the storm's year (through 2025).

fields.name: eaglei_mcc_flag
fields.description: ok, mcc_below_observed_outages (percent out not used) or no_mcc.

fields.name: eaglei_coverage_flag
fields.description: ok, low_coverage (state's minimum covered share below 0.75 that year; kept), coverage_unknown (no published coverage for the year) or no_eaglei_release.
fields.limitations: Coverage is published by state and year only (2018-2022).

fields.name: eaglei_state_min_covered
fields.description: State's minimum share of customers covered by EAGLE-I in the storm year.
fields.limitations: Blank when not published.

fields.name: eaglei_state_max_covered
fields.description: State's maximum share of customers covered in the storm year.
fields.limitations: Blank when not published.

fields.name: min_dist_km
fields.description: Distance from the county's Census internal point to the storm's track (15-minute interpolation).
fields.limitations: NHC HURDAT2; Isaias 2026 from the GIS best track.

fields.name: wind_kt_at_closest
fields.description: Storm's maximum sustained wind at the track point closest to the county.

fields.name: in_34kt
fields.description: True if the county's internal point fell inside the 34-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: in_50kt
fields.description: True if inside the 50-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: in_64kt
fields.description: True if inside the 64-knot wind radii at some time.

fields.name: wind_zone
fields.description: Chapter 7's wind zone from the three radii: inside 64 kt, 50-64 kt, 34-50 kt or outside 34 kt.

fields.name: first_34kt_utc
fields.description: First time the county was inside the 34-knot wind radii.
fields.limitations: Blank if never inside.

fields.name: nearest_landfall_utc
fields.description: The storm's HURDAT2 landfall nearest the county.
fields.limitations: Blank for Isaias 2026 (no landfall marker in the GIS best track).

fields.name: nearest_landfall_km
fields.description: Distance from the county to that landfall.

fields.name: track_source
fields.description: HURDAT2 or GIS best track (Isaias 2026).

fields.name: landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0: the first time the storm's 34-knot wind radii reach a study-state county.
fields.limitations: Same for every county of a storm; see storms.csv.

fields.name: landfall_source
fields.description: Which rule set day 0.

fields.name: days_since_landfall
fields.description: Deprecated alias of days_since_day0 (same values), kept until 4.0.0.
fields.limitations: Use days_since_day0: day 0 is not always a landfall (see landfall_source).

fields.name: days_since_day0
fields.description: Days from day 0 to the report's as-of time (since 3.1.0).

fields.name: svi_overall
fields.description: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 overall national percentile rank (RPL_THEMES).
fields.limitations: Chapter 8's quartiles are of the at-risk storm-counties, not of this column's national cut points.

fields.name: svi_socioeconomic
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 1, socioeconomic status (RPL_THEME1).

fields.name: svi_household
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 2, household characteristics (RPL_THEME2).

fields.name: svi_minority_language
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 3, racial and ethnic minority status (RPL_THEME3).

fields.name: svi_housing_transport
fields.description: SVI 2022 theme 4, housing type and transportation (RPL_THEME4).

fields.name: acs_households
fields.description: Households, ACS 2022 5-year (B11001_001E).

fields.name: acs_population
fields.description: Population, ACS 2022 5-year (B01001_001E).

fields.name: acs_pct_65plus
fields.description: Percent of the population aged 65 or over, ACS 2022 5-year (B01001).

fields.name: acs_pct_broadband
fields.description: Percent of households with a broadband subscription, ACS 2022 5-year (B28002_004E / B28002_001E).

fields.name: bdc_release
fields.description: FCC Broadband Data Collection release matched to the storm: the latest on or before day 0, or the earliest for storms before 2022.

fields.name: bdc_role
fields.description: main (storms from 2022 on) or sensitivity: network data from after the storm.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_half
fields.description: Mobile providers covering at least half the county's area (chapter 13's main measure).
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out; providers are never named.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_any
fields.description: Mobile providers with any coverage in the county.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_any_excl_near_universal
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service, near-universal providers excluded.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_any
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_half
fields.description: Fixed providers serving at least half of residential locations.

fields.name: bdc_fixed_half_excl_near_universal
fields.description: As bdc_fixed_half, near-universal providers excluded.

fields.name: bdc_mobile_half_group
fields.description: Chapter 13's group on bdc_mobile_half: 2 or fewer, 3, or 4 or more (cut points fixed from counts only; results.json v2_5_groups).
fields.limitations: For storms before 2022 (bdc_role 'sensitivity') the release postdates the storm; chapter 13's main analysis uses storms from 2022 on.

fields.name: first_report_date
fields.description: The county's first report in the storm's panel.

fields.name: last_report_date
fields.description: The county's last report in the storm's panel.

fields.name: n_reports_county
fields.description: Reports in the storm's panel that list the county.

fields.name: censoring
fields.description: none, left_reports_while_out (left the reports before the storm's last report while still out) or out_at_last_report.
fields.limitations: Censored counties are not recovered.

resources.name: bdc_county_provider_counts
resources.title: Broadband provider counts by county and BDC release (counts only)
resources.description: Derived from FCC Broadband Data Collection public data; no provider is named or identified.

fields.name: release
fields.description: FCC Broadband Data Collection release (as-of date).

fields.name: fips
fields.description: Five-digit county FIPS code.
fields.limitations: Study-state counties only.

fields.name: mobile_half
fields.description: Mobile broadband providers reporting coverage of at least half of the county.
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out; providers are never named.

fields.name: mobile_any
fields.description: Mobile broadband providers reporting any coverage in the county.
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out.

fields.name: fixed_any_excl_near_universal
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service, near-universal providers excluded.
fields.limitations: Near-universal: service in at least 95% of study-state counties.

fields.name: fixed_any
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service.
fields.limitations: Includes near-universal (likely satellite or national fixed-wireless) providers.

fields.name: fixed_half
fields.description: Fixed providers serving at least half of residential locations.

fields.name: fixed_half_excl_near_universal
fields.description: As fixed_half, near-universal providers excluded.

resources.name: results
resources.title: Every number on the page
resources.description: Chapter results with intervals, n and method, written by code/src/10_analysis.py (chapters 1-9) and 12_v2_analysis.py (chapters 10-14); floats to 10 significant digits.

resources.name: datasheet
resources.title: Datasheet for the dataset
resources.description: Motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing, uses (and uses not supported), known limitations, distribution and maintenance, following Gebru et al.'s Datasheets for Datasets; every number generated from results.json or the data.
